description: Business memo writer — Turn rough notes into a one-page internal memo (TO/FROM/DATE/RE, bottom line up front, background, key points, recommendation, next steps with owners and due dates, risks). Offline checks: numbers not found in your notes, steps missing an owner or date, length, placeholders. Optional: to, from, subject, tone, length (brief|standard|detailed). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

notes.description: e.g. Q3 churn rose to 4.2% from 3.1%. Support tickets up 30%. Propose hiring 2 support agents by Jan 15 to cut response time.

name: ai_memo
